simple.summary: עֱזוּז (ʻĕzûwz) means forcibleness First listed occurrence: Isa 42 25.

definitions.full: H5807. ezuz עֱזוּז noun [masculine] strength, might, fierceness = עֹז ; — construct ׳ע מִלְחָמָה Isa 42:25 fierceness of battle (from ׳י ; + אַמּוֺ חֵמָה ), ׳ע נוֺרְאֹחֶיךָ Psa 145:6 ; suffix וְנִפְלְאֹתָיו עֱזוּזוֺ 78:4 .
